title: model_defaults
description: Schema for modules/model-serving/model_defaults.yaml — validated by check-jsonschema in pre-commit and CI.

allowed_external_models.description: Approved Azure OpenAI model names. Every model field in external_endpoints and additional_external_endpoints must be present here.

allowed_foundation_entities.description: Approved Databricks Foundation Model entity names. Every entity_name in foundation_endpoints and additional_foundation_endpoints must be present here.

external_endpoints.description: Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry model endpoints served via Databricks external model serving.

table_prefix.description: Must be a valid Unity Catalog table-name component: lowercase letters, digits, underscores, starting with a letter.

foundation_endpoints.description: Databricks Foundation Model API endpoints (system.ai.* entity names).

entity_name.description: Fully-qualified Foundation Model entity name, e.g. system.ai.claude_sonnet_4_6

entity_version.description: Entity version string (must be quoted in YAML to stay a string).

disabled_foundation_models.description: Foundation model endpoint names that are blocked workspace-wide (rate_limit = 0).
